answer: Instead of trusting a claimed identity, require every agent to join a live, synchronous coordination session each epoch: a short, real-time group task where participants must react, negotiate, and solve together within the same few minutes. A falcon hunts alone, but a Sybil farmer cannot be in a thousand rooms at once; each fake identity needs its own live, attentive participant, so the cost ripples upward with every copy. The fable of free fake identities ends when presence itself becomes the scarce resource.
